claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Lasalocid is a carboxylic polyether ionophore that transports monovalent and divalent cations across membranes; at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled viability screen it most plausibly kills cells through ionophore-mediated disruption of ion gradients and lysosomal/ER stress, a mechanism shared with other polyether ionophores such as monensin, nigericin, narasin and salinomycin.
